phase_name: Both-engine cutover, prose relocation, full gate run

objectives.description: Extend orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh output with halt/infra_exempt_cycle fields needed for caller-side loop-control (surfaced necessity during cutover; committed as its own green sub-step, outside the Phase 7 atomic batch)
Replace Stage MT-4's per-task postflight steps 1-6 with one call to the new script per dispatched task
Replace single-task Stage 5's gate pair, gates call, and postflight tail with the same call, preserving caller-side loop-control
Retarget test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh at the script's gate and remove the sentinel region from SKILL.md in the same atomic batch
Relocate replaced narrative prose to docs/architecture/
Measure and report bytes removed from SKILL.md
Run a live multi-task /orchestrate cycle through the script and record the outcome

deviations.description: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's output contract (task, phase, status, phases_completed, phases_total, verdict, user_decision?, note) did not expose enough information for a caller to apply loop-control correctly: verdict="failed" is produced both by a genuine in-vocabulary dispatch_status="failed" (should NOT halt) and by an off-schema dispatch_status (SHOULD halt, matching the single-task engine's historical EXIT (partial)); verdict="defer" is produced both by a corroborated infra-exempt cycle (must NOT charge cycle_count) and by ordinary in-budget outcomes (partial dispatch, or implemented with the completion-claim gate refused -- both DO charge). Added two new boolean fields, halt and infra_exempt_cycle, computed from variables already in scope at the script's existing final-output site, with 5 new regression assertions (26/26 total, up from 21/21).
deviations.reason: Necessary correction discovered while implementing Phase 7's explicit requirement to preserve caller-side loop-control (halt / cycle_count / EXIT (partial)); without these fields the cutover could not be implemented correctly. Not part of Phase 7's declared atomic batch (skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md + test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh + docs/architecture/) -- committed as its own preceding green sub-step instead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — extended the Phase-6 script's output contract with halt/infra_exempt_cycle fields, committed separately before the Phase 7 atomic batch)*
